info.title: letfs HTTP transport
info.description: Generated from public HTTP annotations. Native gRPC and byte-stream adapters have separate contracts.

default.description: Application problem; code is stable, detail is diagnostic. Gateway authentication/rate limiting may return native Envoy bodies.

@type.description: A URL/resource name that uniquely identifies the type of the serialized message.

google.protobuf.Any.description: Contains an arbitrary serialized message along with a @type that describes the type of the serialized message.

google.protobuf.Timestamp.description: A point in time in RFC 3339 format, with up to nanosecond precision. Output uses UTC (`Z`); input may use an offset from UTC.

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of google.rpc.Code.

details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details.

google.rpc.Status.description: The Status type defines a logical error model suitable for gRPC and REST APIs.

openlet_api.letfs.v1.BatchStatRequest.title: BatchStatRequest
openlet_api.letfs.v1.BatchStatRequest.description: At most 100 locators; failure is atomic rather than returning foreign/missing metadata.

openlet_api.letfs.v1.CreateNodeRequest.title: CreateNodeRequest
openlet_api.letfs.v1.CreateNodeRequest.description: At most one of `directory`, `file` may be set.

openlet_api.letfs.v1.CreateUploadRequest.title: CreateUploadRequest
openlet_api.letfs.v1.CreateUploadRequest.description: At most one of `destination`, `replacement` may be set.

openlet_api.letfs.v1.Download.title: Download
openlet_api.letfs.v1.Download.description: At most one of `inline_content`, `signed_url` may be set.

openlet_api.letfs.v1.ExistingText.title: ExistingText
openlet_api.letfs.v1.ExistingText.description: Existing writes bind the observed identity and revision. Creation binds parent/name absence.

openlet_api.letfs.v1.FileStat.title: FileStat
openlet_api.letfs.v1.FileStat.description: These representations contain bounded text or blob metadata, never original blob bytes/URLs.

openlet_api.letfs.v1.GetUploadPartsReque.title: GetUploadPartsRequest
openlet_api.letfs.v1.GetUploadPartsReque.description: At most 64 distinct part numbers, each within the admitted native multipart size.

root_id.title: root_id
root_id.description: Traversal boundary inside the scope; omitted uses the ordinary scope root.

openlet_api.letfs.v1.Locator.title: Locator
openlet_api.letfs.v1.Locator.description: At most one of `node_id`, `path` may be set.

context.title: context
context.description: Omitted from list/search metadata; only explicitly requested detail can include context.

openlet_api.letfs.v1.PatchTextRequest.title: PatchTextRequest
openlet_api.letfs.v1.PatchTextRequest.description: At most one of `bytes`, `literal` may be set.

openlet_api.letfs.v1.ReadTextRequest.title: ReadTextRequest
openlet_api.letfs.v1.ReadTextRequest.description: At most one of `whole`, `bytes`, `lines`, `head`, `tail` may be set.

data.title: data
data.description: Each chunk is at most 64 KiB. No archive bytes or signed URLs enter Temporal histories.

openlet_api.letfs.v1.StreamArchiveRespon.title: StreamArchiveResponse
openlet_api.letfs.v1.StreamArchiveRespon.description: At most one of `metadata`, `data` may be set.

before_revision.title: before_revision
before_revision.description: Zero/empty for a creation; otherwise the exact observation before mutation.

openlet_api.letfs.v1.TextSearchRequest.title: TextSearchRequest
openlet_api.letfs.v1.TextSearchRequest.description: Literal candidate selection. Command/regex matching belongs to the caller.

complete.title: complete
complete.description: Incomplete means no payload; the caller may fall back to ordinary permitted reads.

stat.title: stat
stat.description: present only for a complete lines result

openlet_api.letfs.v1.TextTarget.title: TextTarget
openlet_api.letfs.v1.TextTarget.description: At most one of `existing`, `create` may be set.

empty_directory.title: empty_directory
empty_directory.description: Atomically require an ordinary empty directory before moving it to trash.

openlet_api.letfs.v1.Upload.title: Upload
openlet_api.letfs.v1.Upload.description: At most one of `publication`, `receipt` may be set.
